[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < deviceA | 'owner' : nils , 'online' : false , 'buttonPressed' : Pressed , 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA
=> < deviceA | 'owner' : nils , 'online' : true , 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceA : ('owner' : nils , 'key' : Key , ...) > < deviceA | 'owner' : nils , 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceA ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('owner' : UserX , 'key' : Key , ...) > < deviceA | 'owner' : UserX , 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | deviceA : ('owner' : UserX , ...) > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | (deviceA)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('owner' : nils , ...) > $ cloudA 'resetDevice' deviceA .
[B5] < deviceA | 'online' : true , 'owner' : UserY , ... > $ cloudA 'resetDevice' deviceA
=> < deviceA | 'online' : false , 'owner' : nils , ... > .
